STATIC_FLOOR_BREACH.TITLE: {{accountName}} Low Balance Alert
STATIC_FLOOR_BREACH.BODY: {{accountName}} balance (RM {{currentBalance}}) has dropped below its operational floor of RM {{minLimit}}. Please top up at least RM {{shortfall}} immediately (e.g., for toll/parking gates).

LOW_AUTODEBIT_BALANCE.TITLE: Upcoming Auto-Debit Shortfall Warning
LOW_AUTODEBIT_BALANCE.BODY: {{accountName}} requires RM {{requiredAmount}} (including RM {{minLimit}} floor) for upcoming {{commitmentName}} within {{lookAheadDays}} days, but currently holds RM {{currentBalance}}. Suggested Action: Transfer RM {{shortfall}} from {{surplusAccountName}} to {{accountName}}.

IDLE_CASH_SWEEPER.TITLE: Month-End ASNB Idle Cash Sweeper
IDLE_CASH_SWEEPER.BODY: After locking Virtual Envelopes, operational floor, and upcoming auto-debits, {{sourceAccountName}} holds RM {{surplusAmount}} in 0% idle cash. Sweep RM {{surplusAmount}} into {{asnbAccountName}} before the 1st of next month to capture ~RM {{projectedMonthlyYield}}/month in dividends.

ASNB_DEPOSIT_TIMING_TIP.TITLE: ASNB Deposit Timing Tip (Minimum Monthly Balance Rule)
ASNB_DEPOSIT_TIMING_TIP.BODY: You deposited RM {{depositAmount}} into {{accountName}} on Day {{dayOfMonth}}. Because ASNB calculates monthly dividends on the lowest balance held between Day 1 and month-end, this deposit will start earning full monthly dividends (~RM {{missedDividend}}/mo) from next month. Tip: Transfer between the 25th and last day of the month!
